title: CLI CRUD commands (list/read/create/update/delete)
description: Implement five subcommands against the NoteAPI: list (optional --tag/--q filter), read (--id required), create (--title, --content required), update (--id required, --title/--content optional), delete (--id required). Each command calls the API and prints results to stdout. Non-zero exit on API error.

title: CLI help system and input validation
description: The CLI must support --help/-h flags globally and per subcommand, printing usage and exiting 0. Input validation must reject empty or whitespace-only arguments with a clear error message and non-zero exit code. No stack traces in error output.

title: Add input validation for empty or blank strings
description: When user passes empty string or whitespace-only string as argument, reject with clear error message. Non-zero exit code. Add unit test. Ref: gh-toy-v6z.

title: Add --version flag to CLI
description: The CLI tool should support a --version (or -v) flag that prints the current version string and exits with code 0. Acceptance: running ./tool --version prints fleet-e2e-toy v1.0.0, exit code 0, works alongside other flags.

title: [impl] Add --help/-h flags globally and per subcommand
description:
Support --help and -h at the top level (prints global usage listing subcommands, exits 0) and per subcommand (prints that subcommand's usage and flags, exits 0). Wire into the CLI parser/dispatcher.
Files: src/cli/help.ts, src/cli/index.ts.
Done: 'cli --help' and 'cli <sub> --help' both print usage and exit 0.
acceptance_criteria: Top-level --help/-h prints global usage and exits 0; each subcommand --help prints its usage and exits 0; no stack traces.

title: [impl] Implement create, update, and delete subcommands
description:
Implement 'create' (--title, --content required, POST /api/notes), 'update' (--id required, --title/--content optional, PUT /api/notes/:id), and 'delete' (--id required, DELETE /api/notes/:id). Print result to stdout; non-zero exit on API error.
Files: src/cli/commands/create.ts, src/cli/commands/update.ts, src/cli/commands/delete.ts, wire into dispatcher.
Done: create makes a note and prints it; update modifies fields; delete removes by id; each errors non-zero on API failure.
acceptance_criteria: create requires --title/--content and prints the created note; update applies provided fields; delete removes the note; all three exit non-zero on API error.
notes: cost-estimate: bucket=L model=standard doer_tokens=2800 reviewer_tokens=1232 output_usd=0.0605

title: [impl] Implement list and read subcommands
description:
Implement 'list' (optional --tag and --q filters, calls GET /api/notes with query params) and 'read' (--id required, calls GET /api/notes/:id). Print notes to stdout. Non-zero exit on API error or 404.
Files: src/cli/commands/list.ts, src/cli/commands/read.ts, wire into dispatcher.
Done: list prints all notes and respects --tag/--q; read prints a single note by id; missing --id on read errors non-zero.
acceptance_criteria: list returns notes and honors --tag/--q filters; read --id prints the matching note; read with missing/invalid id exits non-zero with a clear error.
notes: cost-estimate: bucket=M model=standard doer_tokens=1400 reviewer_tokens=616 output_usd=0.0302

title: [impl] Scaffold CLI entrypoint and command dispatcher
description:
Create the CLI entrypoint (src/cli/index.ts) with an argument parser and a subcommand dispatcher that routes to list/read/create/update/delete handlers. Add an npm bin script. Each subcommand calls the NoteAPI over HTTP and prints results to stdout; on API error, print an error message (no stack trace) and exit non-zero.
Files: src/cli/index.ts, package.json (bin entry).
Done: running the CLI with no/unknown subcommand prints usage and exits non-zero; dispatcher wires the five subcommand handlers (which may be stubs at this point).
acceptance_criteria: CLI entrypoint exists and dispatches to five named subcommands; unknown subcommand exits non-zero with a message; no stack traces leak to stdout/stderr.
notes: cost-estimate: bucket=M model=standard doer_tokens=1400 reviewer_tokens=616 output_usd=0.0302

title: Add config file support (~/.fleet-e2e-toy.yaml)
description: Allow users to persist default flag values in a YAML config file at ~/.fleet-e2e-toy.yaml so they don't have to repeat common flags on every run. Acceptance: reads config on startup, CLI flags override config, warns on unknown keys, documents supported keys in README.

title: Handle SIGINT gracefully (Ctrl-C)
description: The tool should catch SIGINT (Ctrl-C) and exit cleanly without a Python traceback or incomplete output. Acceptance: Ctrl-C prints 'Interrupted.' and exits with code 130, no stack trace shown, partial output files cleaned up.

title: Add JSON output mode via --json flag
description: Add a --json flag so all command output can be emitted as machine-readable JSON for scripting and CI pipelines. Acceptance: --json flag accepted on any subcommand, output is valid JSON, human-readable output is default, errors also JSON-formatted.

title: Tag filtering endpoint
description: GET /api/notes?tag=work returns only notes with that tag. Already partially implemented - needs tests.
